items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: Renee Fleming came into my dressing room... we had our little woodwind ensemble... Renee making sure that she could time them right.

ctx.x: When you had a guest like Renee Fleming, oh yow, speaking of learning on the job, was that a challenge? I think your buddy Tom “Bones” Malone related a story about how that occurred.

Certainly it was challenging for me. Again when you’re dealing with the written page, it’s not my forte. Nonetheless I was having to run this thing, and luckily Tom was not booked and was able to write the key arrangements for me that we needed. But first of all it’s Renee Fleming sings the Top Ten in some way. Now I can’t quite remember whether it was special lyrics, our writer, who shall remain nameless right now although he did a marvelous job, but I said you know in a case like Renee Fleming let’s see what…
I was going to ask you about the residuals.
